body: Boeing projects in its 2026 World Air Cargo Forecast that air cargo traffic will double over the next 20 years, growing 3.5% a year, and that the global freighter fleet will grow 67%, from 2,395 airplanes in 2025 to 4,010 in 2045. Operators will need 2,930 new and converted freighters over that period, with about 55% of deliveries adding capacity and about 45% replacing older, less efficient freighters. Two-thirds of deliveries will be converted passenger airplanes and the rest new-production freighters.

Global air cargo traffic reached a new annual record in 2025, growing nearly 5% from 2024 despite trade volatility and geopolitical disruptions, and Boeing expects trade flows touching Asia to lead growth at about 60% of the global market. E-commerce, direct-to-consumer models and demand for high-tech goods are driving growth, and according to IATA data cited by Boeing, more than 70% of AI-related goods were transported by air in 2025. Dedicated freighters are expected to carry more than half of global air cargo traffic in the long term, while integrators offering time-definite and express services are expected to reach nearly 25% of traffic by 2045.

Boeing released the forecast on October 28 at the International Air Cargo Association's Air Cargo Forum in Miami. The company notes that goods carried by air represent less than 1% of global trade by volume but roughly one-third of trade value, and that about 55% of air cargo traffic, measured in cargo tonne-kilometers, has historically moved on main-deck freighters.
en.summary: Boeing's 2026 World Air Cargo Forecast projects traffic doubling by 2045, the freighter fleet growing to 4,010 airplanes, and 2,930 new and converted freighters needed over 20 years.
en.title: Boeing sees demand for nearly 3,000 freighters as cargo traffic doubles by 2045

body: 波音2026年世界航空貨運預測指出，未來20年航空貨運量將翻倍、年均成長3.5%，全球貨機機隊將成長67%，由2025年的2395架增至2045年的4010架。業者在20年間將需要2930架全新與改裝貨機，其中約55%用於增加運能、約45%用於汰換老舊且效率較低的貨機；交付量中約三分之二為客機改裝貨機，其餘為全新製造貨機。
2025年全球航空貨運量創下年度新高，較2024年成長近5%，儘管當時存在貿易波動與地緣政治干擾；波音預期涉及亞洲的貿易流將引領成長，約占全球市場的60%。電商、直面消費者商業模式與高科技產品需求是成長動能，根據波音引用的IATA資料，2025年超過70%的人工智慧相關貨物以空運運輸。專用貨機預期長期仍將承運超過一半的全球航空貨運量，而提供限時與快遞服務的業者市占預期在2045年達到近25%。
波音於10月28日在邁阿密舉行的國際航空貨運協會航空貨運論壇發布這份預測。波音指出，空運貨物占全球貿易量不到1%，但約占貿易價值的三分之一；以貨運噸公里計算，歷史上約55%的航空貨運量由主貨艙貨機承運。
